mapper.select:
select o.outbox_id, o.created_at, o.topic, o.biz_key, o.status, o.attempts, o.max_attempts, case when o.status in ('NEW', 'SENDING') then o.next_retry_at end as next_retry_at, o.sent_at, left(o.last_error, 200) as last_error, o.retry_cnt, (o.close_apr_id is not null) as close_pending
order by o.created_at desc, o.outbox_id desc limit #{q.page.size} offset #{q.page.offset}
mapper.sql: o.outbox_id, o.message_id::text as message_id, o.created_at, o.created_by, o.topic, o.biz_key, o.status, o.attempts, o.max_attempts, o.next_retry_at, o.sent_at, o.last_error, o.payload::text as payload, o.retry_cnt, o.retried_at, o.retried_by, o.closed_at, o.closed_by, o.close_reason, o.close_apr_id
mapper.select: select , a.status as close_apr_status from sys_outbox o left join apr_request a on a.apr_id = o.close_apr_id where o.outbox_id = #{outboxId}
select from sys_outbox o where o.outbox_id = #{outboxId} for update
mapper.update: update sys_outbox set status = 'NEW', attempts = 0, next_retry_at = now(), locked_at = null, retry_cnt = retry_cnt + 1, retried_at = now(), retried_by = #{by} where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'FAIL' and close_apr_id is null
update sys_outbox set status = 'CLOSED_MANUAL', closed_at = now() where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'FAIL' and close_apr_id is not null
update sys_outbox set close_apr_id = null, close_reason = null, closed_by = null where outbox_id = #{outboxId} and status = 'FAIL' and close_apr_id is not null
mapper.select: select topic, count(*) as cnt from sys_outbox where status = 'FAIL' and close_apr_id is null group by topic order by cnt desc, topic
select count(*) from sys_outbox where status = 'FAIL' and close_apr_id is not null
select outbox_id, topic, biz_key, left(last_error, 80) as last_error, created_at from sys_outbox where status = 'FAIL' and close_apr_id is null order by created_at, outbox_id limit #{limit}
